item.text: {"calibration_results":[{"calibration_case_id":"calibration:complete-frame-mismatch","evidence_basis":"stated_evidence_only","invented_material_premise":false,"rationale":"Demonstrated denominator/scope mismatch: the registered target covers all 100 planned locations, but the only selected result uses the 73 retained locations while claiming a planned-region rate, and no amendment or approved deviation exists. A valid scope change would falsify this issue, but the vignette explicitly excludes one.","verdict":"demonstrated_issue"},{"calibration_case_id":"calibration:conditional-subset-scope","evidence_basis":"stated_evidence_only","invented_material_premise":false,"rationale":"The target, denominator, and reported claim all concern exactly the 73 signal-eligible locations. A broader claim or all-location target would demonstrate a mismatch, but neither is stated.","verdict":"no_demonstrated_issue_within_scope"},{"calibration_case_id":"calibration:full-frame-accounting","evidence_basis":"stated_evidence_only","invented_material_premise":false,"rationale":"The result matches the all-100-location target: all 100 remain in the denominator, the 27 unavailable measurements are recorded, and the reported rate is full-frame. Excluding unavailable locations from the denominator would falsify this conclusion, but the stated evidence says they were retained.","verdict":"no_demonstrated_issue_within_scope"},{"calibration_case_id":"calibration:unrelated-quality-endpoint","evidence_basis":"stated_evidence_only","invented_material_premise":false,"rationale":"The scientific result uses all 100 planned locations. The 73-record fraction belongs to a separate quality-control table explicitly excluded from the scientific endpoint. It would create an issue if that subset fraction were used as the endpoint, but the vignette states the opposite.","verdict":"no_demonstrated_issue_within_scope"},{"calibration_case_id":"calibration:conflicting-scope-records","evidence_basis":"stated_evidence_only","invented_material_premise":false,"rationale":"The selected eligible-location result agrees with one signed plan but conflicts with the other equally authoritative signed plan, and neither has precedence. Establishing precedence would falsify the ambiguity, but the stated evidence does not do so.","verdict":"conditional_or_unknown"},{"calibration_case_id":"calibration:no-selected-result","evidence_basis":"stated_evidence_only","invented_material_premise":false,"rationale":"The preserved record does not identify which runtime-selected report, if any, supported the scientific claim. Evidence identifying the selected report would permit a scope comparison, but none is stated, so no specific analysis issue can be assessed.","verdict":"insufficient_evidence"}],"reviewer_participant_id":"actor:stage1-codex-02"}
